response.justification: While the candidate has strong experience in software development, their background is heavily skewed toward modern web technologies (JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React) and lacks the depth in C++ and industrial automation required for this role. Their C++ experience is limited to early career roles and not recent, and they do not demonstrate familiarity with industrial protocols, secure development lifecycle (SDL), or IEC 62443 standards. Security expertise and cloud exposure are also missing.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience with modern technologies (Node.js, React, TypeScript)
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills evidenced by diverse projects and roles
Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them in practical scenarios
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience (last significant role in 2015) and no clear evidence of C++/STL proficiency
No visible experience with industrial automation, message brokers, or IoT protocols (e.g., MQTT, Modbus TCP/IP)
Lacks key security expertise (SDL, IEC 62443) and cloud platform experience (Azure)

key_factors.factor: Experience with industrial automation and relevant protocols
Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) and IEC 62443 compliance
